selectedContract.naturalCost: Forgo the prior-turn play or Kindle, receive one fewer normal draw, then pay and legally play the exact retained Attack before expiry.

selectedContract.policyExposure: Frozen existing policies first with no hold, score, acquisition or target control; direct telemetry records producer, mediator-set, carry/draw replacement, consumer, consume, payoff requested/realised and exact expiry.
selectedContract.producer: After hand penalties at Dusk END_TURN, select the first authored Attack remaining in existing hand order; at most one exact UID.
